About Me

Hi! I’m Roya Moussapour.

I’m an experienced UX researcher and strategist currently working at Capital One as a Lead UX Researcher in Developer Experience. My current work focuses on navigating complex technical systems to build intuitive workflows and products for software engineers.

I’m currently located in Baltimore, MD, but am relocating to Gloucestershire, England, in July 2026. I have full UK work authorisation and am open to full-time roles in the UK as well as contract (1099) roles in the US.

I previously worked at the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office leading research on their new trademark filing platform. Before that, I was a contract researcher at Bloom Works, a public interest tech company, and Director of Research at Lumen Learning, an educational technology company. In between, I worked in strategy consulting at Kaiser Associates.

I received my initial research training at MIT during my master’s degree while working at the MIT Teaching Systems Lab as a researcher.

If you’d like a copy of my current UK CV, you can access it here.
